result.quote: I found that the accusation involved questions about their own law, but there was no charge worthy of death or imprisonment.
result.reason: The key paraphrases part of verse 29, but the question broadly asks what the captain said, so other details—such as finding no charge worthy of death or imprisonment, learning of a plot, sending Paul, and instructing the accusers—are also defensible answers. The window also does not itself identify the speaker as a captain or the recipient as Felix. Add articles and narrow the question, for example: “What did the captain say the accusation against Paul involved?”
